# Photo conventions

## Semantic:
- Put the date the photos were taken in the text, not in the files.

## Technical:
- Crop the photos of one guide to the same size.
- Strip all metadata (EXIF, GPS, timestamps) before committing a photo.
- Keep the original photos out of the repository.
